sentences.text: 7. Pursuant to the above settlement, the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have been granted divorce vide decree of divorce dated 20.10.2023 passed by the learned Family Court in HMA 3126/2023 titled as Sh.Pankaj Kumar v. Smt. Moni.
8. The petitioners have handed over a Demand Draft of Rs.5,50,000/- to the respondent no.2 in Court.

9. The respondent no.2 who is present in person in Court and has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer (IO), affirms the settlement and states that she has settled all the disputes with the petitioners of her own free will and without any coercion.
The respondent no.2 submits that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
10. I have perused the contents of the FIR and also the settlement between the parties.

11. As the disputes between the parties arose out of a matrimonial relationship, and now the same have been amicably settled, a decree of divorce has also been passed by the learned Family Court pursuant to the settlement, and also looking into the nature of the allegations made in the complaint, in my opinion, no useful purpose would be served in
